name: Nahum
title: Nahum — Nineveh’s Fall
tagline: The LORD is slow to anger — and great in power.

date.range_display: Before Nineveh’s fall (612 BC); after Assyrian cruelty peaked.

purpose: Comfort by announcing justice on a bloody empire.
christ: Judge of nations; feet that bring good news (echo Isa 52).
jesus_in_this_book: Judge of nations; feet that bring good news (echo Isa 52).
how_to_read: Pair with Jonah — mercy offered, judgment when cruelty hardens.
watchman_charge: Do not envy violent empires. Trust the Judge’s timeline.
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
